editorial:
Imagine moving across the world for a dream scholarship only to find out that being smart isn't enough to fit in. You follow a brilliant Chinese student who lands a spot at a top New Zealand college, but she quickly realizes that the social ladder is brutal. She is awkward and lonely, but she has a dark secret and a level of skill that makes her dangerous. The vibe starts off like a typical school drama, but it quickly turns into a bloody nightmare as she decides to carve her way into the popular crowd. It is a wild ride that mixes school stress with some really gross and shocking moments.

The acting is surprisingly strong, and the way the tension builds up makes the kills feel earned. While the middle part slows down a bit, the gore is top-notch and the twists will keep you guessing. If you love movies about people snapping under pressure, you will love this. It is a great pick for a weekend watch with friends.
endingExplained: In the final act, you see the student fully embrace her dark side to eliminate anyone in her way. She uses her medical knowledge to literally graft parts of others to herself or others to gain power and status. After a bloody showdown with her rivals, she finally gets the popularity she wanted, but she has lost her humanity. The movie ends with her standing at the top of the social hill, covered in blood and completely insane.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark stories about revenge and body horror.
